description: In-place PostgreSQL 14 → 16 major version upgrade using pg_upgrade on a production database with 200GB data and ~3,000 writes/second. Must: take base backup, install PG16 binaries, run pg_upgrade --check, stop application writes during maintenance window (Saturday 02:00-04:00 UTC), run pg_upgrade --link-mode, start PG16, run ANALYZE, verify application compatibility, and have rollback plan (restore from base backup if upgrade fails). Risk factors: pg_upgrade --link-mode is irreversible (hard links), extension compatibility between PG14 and PG16, query plan regression from new planner stats, shared_preload_libraries changes. Tools available: pg_upgrade, pg_dump, pg_basebackup, psql, ansible, CI/CD.
